# chunk.with_chunk_index { #polars_corpus.chunk.with_chunk_index }

```python
chunk.with_chunk_index(df, column, name='chunk_idx')
```

Add a column with chunk IDs based on BIO tags.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type    | Description                                              | Default       |
|--------|---------|----------------------------------------------------------|---------------|
| df     | T_Frame | DataFrame or LazyFrame with BIO-tagged column.           | _required_    |
| column | str     | Name of column containing BIO tags.                      | _required_    |
| name   | str     | Name for the new chunk ID column (default: "chunk_idx"). | `'chunk_idx'` |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type    | Description                                        |
|--------|---------|----------------------------------------------------|
|        | T_Frame | DataFrame or LazyFrame with added chunk ID column. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> import polars as pl
>>> from polars_corpus import with_chunk_index
>>> df = pl.DataFrame({"bio": ["B", "I", "O", "B", "I"]})
>>> with_chunk_index(df, "bio")
shape: (5, 2)
┌─────┬───────────┐
│ bio ┆ chunk_idx │
│ --- ┆ ---       │
│ str ┆ i64       │
╞═════╪═══════════╡
│ B   ┆ 1         │
│ I   ┆ 1         │
│ O   ┆ null      │
│ B   ┆ 2         │
│ I   ┆ 2         │
└─────┴───────────┘
```
